page.overview:
What is Skirmish at Bakerstown?

A skirmish place on at the settlement Bakerstown on the planet Vernid when two New Republic agents attempted to arrest the ex-Imperial Soran Keize, who subsequently murdered the pair with the help of his dig-rig crewmate Klevin.

The skirmish first appeared in the 2019 novel Alphabet Squadron, the first installment of Alexander Freed's Star Wars: Alphabet Squadron trilogy.
